company.notes: Entered in the Zug commercial register on 26 September 2024 (statutes 4 September 2024, SOGC publication 1 October 2024); share capital CHF 20,000. The register gives Bahnhofplatz without a house number. The phone is the number the company put on its hero and contact page in April 2026 and that appears in the footer contact block (02 section 2). The WhatsApp link documented on the current site uses the older number +41 76 418 63 50, so whatsapp is left empty (button not rendered) until the client confirms which number carries WhatsApp; it must then equal company.phone. Use legalName in the footer, Impressum and Organization schema, shortName in prose; never the plural form of the name and never the three-letter abbreviation on its own.
clientToConfirm: Primary phone: +41 76 595 88 61 is used here (hero and contact page since April 2026). Two other numbers are in circulation: +41 76 418 63 50 (current header button and WhatsApp) and +41 76 358 84 90 (Swiss Aerospace Cluster directory). footer.legalLine: Flight Hour Solution GmbH, Bahnhofplatz, 6300 Zug, Switzerland. UID CHE-196.248.398.
footer.disclosure:
Advisory: independent engine management consulting. Flight Hour Solution is not owned by an MRO, a lessor or an OEM and works for the client.
Assets: engine and aircraft sourcing, sales support and listings. When we broker an asset we say so. Advisory clients are never offered our own inventory without disclosure.
footer.notes: The copyright year is not part of legalLine; the footer component renders the current year so it cannot go stale (the old site carried a hard-coded year). The disclosure holds two labelled lines separated by a newline, per 07 section 2.3 option 1 (Advisory and Assets under one brand with a written conflicts policy). Ownership fact behind the independence line: Hubert Nowosad has held all 200 shares since July 2025 (01 section 2).
clientToConfirm: Confirm the Advisory line takes no commissions from MROs, OEMs or lessors, so the disclosure can also say fee-only.

Confirm that engine and aircraft trading is an official service line to present as Assets on the site.
